about: OpenCode free models through the unmodified OpenCode CLI, exposed as OpenAI chat completions for the local Soul Gateway.

agent-card.summary: Plain-text chat through OpenCode's free models.
agent-card.description: Seven zero-cost OpenCode models (big-pickle, ling-3.0-flash-fin-free, mimo-v2.5-free, muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free, muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free, nemotron-3-ultra-free, nemotron-3.5-lightning-free) behind the unmodified OpenCode CLI; no tool calls, no images, one chunk per answer.
agent-card.whenToUse: Plain-text answers where several seconds of latency and a shared free quota are acceptable.
agent-card.whenNotToUse: Tool calling, vision, autocomplete, confidential prompts (free-model data-use terms).
agent-card.inputConventions: OpenAI chat messages with text content only; system, user and assistant roles; the last message is the user turn.
agent-card.outputConventions: One assistant text; streamed replies carry the whole answer in one content delta.

OPENCODE_FREE_API_KEY.description: Overrides the bundled restricted OpenCode key; empty keeps the bundled key.
